subject: Vintage mechanical keyboards with beige cases and colorful keycaps

sources.description: Deskthority wiki page for IBM Model M -- multiple high-res photos showing top-down, profile, and detail views of the most iconic vintage keyboard. Neutral backgrounds, consistent lighting.
Deskthority wiki page for IBM Model F XT and AT variants. Earlier, heavier design with capacitive buckling spring. Multiple angle shots showing darker beige case and unique keycap profiles.
Deskthority wiki page for Cherry G80-3000 series. Classic German keyboard with colorful dye-sublimated PBT keycaps on beige case. Shows the quintessential European vintage keyboard aesthetic.
Apple Extended Keyboard II with Alps SKCM switches. Distinctive Apple design language in cream/beige. Good for adding non-IBM variety to the dataset.
Reddit r/MechanicalKeyboards vintage flair posts sorted by top of all time. High engagement posts tend to have professional-quality photos. Diverse range of boards, angles, and desk setups.
Geekhack Keyboards sub-forum with vintage keyboard appreciation threads. Multi-image posts with detailed collection photography dating back years.
ClickyKeyboards vintage IBM specialist. Product photos of restored Model M and Model F keyboards in clean condition. White backgrounds, consistent angles across listings.
Drop.com GMK keycap set product pages (GMK 9009, GMK Retro, GMK Classic Retro). Professional studio photography of retro-themed keycaps on modern boards. Excellent lighting and composition.
NovelKeys keycap collections including Cherry-profile retro sets. Product photography with styled desk setups showing the vintage aesthetic on clean backgrounds.
Flickr search results for vintage mechanical keyboards. Artistic photography with creative lighting and compositions. Needs more filtering but adds photographic diversity.
Chyrosran22 IBM Model M review video (1080p). Detailed close-ups of keycaps, switches, case details, and typing demonstrations. Good for extracting detail shots not found in static photos.
Chyrosran22 Cherry G80 with dye-sub keycaps review. Shows European vintage keyboards with colorful legends in detail. 1080p quality.
TaeKeyboards vintage keyboard collection tour. Showcases multiple boards in sequence -- good for extracting a variety of different keyboards from one source.
eBay vintage keyboard listings. Varied quality but sometimes the only source for rarer boards. Possible seller watermarks -- flag during curation.
Pinterest boards for vintage mechanical keyboard aesthetics. Curated collections, mixed resolution. Many reposts from Reddit/Geekhack that dedup will catch.

notes: Tier A sources (Deskthority, Reddit, Geekhack) form the backbone. Tier B adds professional photography and lighting variety. Tier C video sources supplement with close-up detail shots. Expect significant filtering -- many images will be duplicates across sources or below quality threshold.
